spec.section: ## Scope This restores an archived session into a new local session. It never resumes or copies a live Hermes database.

## Ordered procedure
1. Acquire an explicit archive read grant and discover the target `SessionArchive`. 2. Select the latest committed `ExportManifest`; if none exists, stop with `restore_failed{reason:no_committed_manifest}` and retain the gap records. 3. Fetch the payload, recompute SHA-256, and compare `payload_digest`. A mismatch stops with `restore_failed{reason:digest_mismatch}`. 4. Check `export_schema.name == hermes.session.export` and a supported version. An unsupported version stops with `restore_failed{reason:export_version_unsupported}`. 5. Import into a freshly created local Hermes session; never reuse the archived session id. 6. Import the checkpoint policy snapshot. If absent, fail closed to `current_policy` and record `snapshot_missing`. 7. Create a new bond generation, record imported checkpoint and archive identity, and route delayed old-generation messages to the retired generation. 8. Emit a restore report with completeness, coverage window, open gaps, new session id and new bond id.

## Evidence Read back grant, manifest, digest, schema version, snapshot decision, new session/bond and restore report. Expected test: `T-ARC-RESTORE`; a successful archive read alone is not proof of a live-session restore.
